name: Bashal'Aran
summary: In northern Darkshore, Bashal'Aran's ruins draw satyrs and grells to lingering magic. A lone elven ghost remains bound by a curse centuries old.

sections.title: A Shattered Twin City
sections.body:
Before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne in Bashal'Aran and its twin, Ameth'Aran. The mage Athrikus Narassin governed both towns. Their splendid markets and temples honored Elune.

When the Well of Eternity collapsed, the cataclysm destroyed both settlements. For reasons lost to time, Athrikus used his arcane mastery to bind his second-in-command, the mage Asterion, inside a moonstone seal in Bashal'Aran. Asterion's body perished, but his ghost remained shackled to the ruined shrine.

sections.title: Demonic Infestation
sections.body:
Deth'ryll satyrs and grells claim Bashal'Aran's crumbled stones. Drawn by magic lingering in the ancient masonry, they feed on its energy to strengthen their foul arts. They swarm the broken courtyards and terrorize travelers on Darkshore's forest paths.

Yet the creatures keep clear of the central shrine, where Asterion endures his endless vigil.

faq.q: What was Bashal'Aran before it was destroyed?
faq.answer: Before its destruction, Bashal'Aran was a magnificent Kaldorei city where Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne aristocrats. The mage-lord Athrikus Narassin governed it alongside its twin, Ameth'Aran.

faq.q: Who is the ghost wandering the shrine?
faq.answer: Asterion's ghost wanders the shrine, where he remains imprisoned beyond mortal death. His governor, Athrikus Narassin, mysteriously betrayed him and bound him there with a moonstone seal.

faq.q: Why are satyrs inhabiting the ruins?
faq.answer: Satyrs and grells came to Bashal'Aran, drawn by arcane energy left by the ancient Highborne. They feed on its lingering magic to strengthen their dark demonic arts.

faq.q: How does Bashal'Aran relate to Ameth'Aran?
faq.answer: Bashal'Aran and Ameth'Aran were sister cities governed together under Queen Azshara. Before the Sundering shattered both settlements, Asterion often journeyed between them to tend to the people's needs.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, Bashal'Aran recalls the arcane hubris that doomed the ancient Kaldorei Empire and left its ruins open to demonic corruption.
As a Mage, Asterion's moonstone seal shows how Highborne spellcraft can bind a spirit beyond mortal death.
